text.description_html:
Acorn AH6BQ, 4" Smooth Iron H-L Hinge

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths. The 4 Inch Smooth Iron H-L Hinge can be used on either interior or exterior doors. The H-L Hinge's smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Specifications of the 4 Inch Smooth Black Iron Hinge:

  • Suitable as heavy cabinet hinges or for use on light interior doors.
  • Height: 4"
  • Overall Width: 4-1/16"

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges).
